text:
The deal offers a mix of cash and stock: for each Kenvue Common Stock share, holders will receive 0.14625 shares of Kimberly-Clark Common Stock plus $3.50 in cash, with fractional shares settled under the related provisions.
Stock Consideration: 0.14625 Kimberly-Clark Common Stock per Kenvue share; Cash Consideration: $3.50 per Kenvue share; Fractional Share Consideration: cash in lieu of fractional shares; Unpaid Dividends payable on surrender. No CVR is mentioned in the provided text.
0.14625 Kimberly-Clark Common Stock per Kenvue Common Stock, plus $3.50 in cash per share; fractional share consideration is paid in cash in accordance with Section 3.02(d).
